senses.definition_en: the practice of using la as indirect object pronoun when referring to feminine nouns, instead of the standard le

examples.english: Laísmo consists of using direct object pronouns (la, las) as the form of the indirect object referring to feminine nouns, whose forms should be le, les: A María la rompieron la falda "They tore María's skirt" (correct: le).

examples.text: El laísmo consiste en emplear los pronombres de complemento directo (la, las) como forma de complemento indirecto referido a sustantivos femeninos, cuyas formas deben ser le, les: A María la rompieron la falda (correcto, le)
examples.translation: Laísmo consists of using direct object pronouns (la, las) as the form of the indirect object referring to feminine nouns, whose forms should be le, les: A María la rompieron la falda "They tore María's skirt" (correct: le).

glosses: the practice of using la as indirect object pronoun when referring to feminine nouns, instead of the standard le
